name: ESMA — Financial Instruments Reference Data System (FIRDS) full files
access: HTTPS GET: file list from registers.esma.europa.eu/solr/esma_registers_firds_files (JSON), then the FULINS_E zip files it names (ISO 20022 auth.017 XML); no key
cost_model: Free of charge (public register under MiFIR Art. 27)

rate_limit.source: No limit published on pages reachable 2026-10-23. Self-imposed: one request every 5 s (the equity full files are tens of megabytes).

failure_behavior: HTTP 502 from the register host (observed on every request 2026-10-23) or other 5xx: bounded backoff, then the run fails and reports the status; no instrument is invented. XML with a DTD or entity declarations is refused.

datasets.description: Equity instrument reference data (ISIN, trading venue MIC, CFI, full name, notional currency, issuer LEI, first trade and termination dates) limited to the EU equity MICs in config/markets/venues.json
datasets.endpoint: https://firds.esma.europa.eu/firds/FULINS_E_<YYYYMMDD>_<NN>of<MM>.zip (names taken from the file list, never guessed)
datasets.coverage: Instruments admitted to trading or traded on EU venues; this system keeps venues XETR, XPAR, XAMS, XBRU, XLIS, XMIL, XMAD (registry venues in EU countries)
datasets.history_depth: Current full file only (one snapshot per run)
datasets.update_frequency: Full files published weekly, delta files daily (ESMA reporting instructions)
datasets.availability_rule: Reference data, not a time series: each record is available from its receipt time (first seen); a changed value on a later snapshot is a new publication flagged revised_after_first_seen.
datasets.rights_source: REGISTERS legal notice: 'Reproduction of all information on this site (REGISTERS information) is authorised except as otherwise stated, provided the source is acknowledged and' further numbered conditions; third-party material needs the holder's permission. Read 2026-10-23 through search-engine extracts only: the register host answered HTTP 502 and www.esma.europa.eu HTTP 403 to automated retrieval, so the full condition list is unverified. Verdict: single-owner research storage with source acknowledgement allowed; no redistribution until the full notice is read; cloud-model processing withheld.
datasets.rights_status: partially verified 2026-10-23 (condition list unread); no live ingestion succeeded
